ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark-grey) to high-intensity (white/light-grey) pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Predominantly dark-pixel substrate populated by a dense network of high-contrast white linear filaments. A localized, contiguous high-intensity white patch is positioned at the far left lateral tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-amplitude, irregular serrations along the trailing edge; a distinct high-amplitude jagged discontinuity is present at the right distal terminal.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lateral convex curves tapering from the median notch toward the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: High-density distribution of multidirectional, overlapping linear white pixel streaks across both fluke lobes, concentrated heavily in the central and upper-left quadrants.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Physical tissue irregularity and brownish-red discoloration at the distal tip of the right fluke lobe, suggesting structural damage.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly complex, non-repeating geometric pattern formed by the intersection of dozens of linear white abrasions against the dark ventral base.
